hook: In pooled credit, the primary failure mode is contagion.
body: A forced liquidation in a shared pool transmits bad debt across solvent participants. Containing this risk requires confining shortfalls to the individual position. When losses cannot cross the boundary of a single account, bad debt cannot dilute broader capital reserves.
